title: Phantom Blade Zero Characters - Soul, Zuoshang, Mu Xiaokui & More
description: Every Phantom Blade Zero character confirmed by S-GAME: Soul is the only playable protagonist, with Zuoshang, Mu Xiaokui, The Flesh Sculptor and Mo Yuan around him.

sections.title: Who You Can Actually Play
sections.content:
One character. Soul. The Wikipedia entry for the game lists its mode as single-player and states plainly that “the player controls the elite assassin Soul”, and the official PlayStation.Blog breakdown from the August 2026 State of Play describes the same thing from the design side: you are Soul walking the Wulin, meeting citizens, taking side quests that can open new story paths. No second playable character has been announced.

An earlier version of this page claimed four playable characters and named The Chord among them. That was wrong, and the mistake is instructive rather than just embarrassing: The Chord is a real Phantom Blade character, but from the series' mobile entries - Phantom Blade: Executioners and Phantom Blade 3 - where Soul, Mu Xiaokui, Zuo Shang, The Chord and Lackey are all playable together. Those rosters do not carry into Phantom Blade Zero, and reading a mobile-game character list onto this one is how a lot of pre-launch “information” about this game has been manufactured.

The likeliest source of the confusion is the music. Composer Caisheng Bo confirmed that Soul, Mu Xiaokui and Zuoshang each have their own thematic melody, and that all three descend from the same A minor theme so they blend. Three characters with three leitmotifs reads like three playable characters. It is not.

sections.title: Soul (魂) - The Protagonist
sections.content:
Soul is an elite assassin of The Order, a secretive and powerful organisation whose true motives appear to be hidden even from its own members. He is framed for the murder of its patriarch - the man who raised him - and hunted by his former comrades.

The wound and the clock

The story's engine is a sword duel. Soul fights Zuoshang, and the two were once blood brothers; during that duel Soul takes a fatal wound to the heart. The Flesh Sculptor, a mysterious healer, revives him with a tainted heart - and the cure is temporary. Soul has 66 days to restore his heart and expose whoever framed him.

How he fights

Soul carries two primary weapons and two secondary ones. Primaries are blades; the secondaries are Phantom Edges, a deliberately unruly set including cannons, lances, axes and hammers. Switching between them is not just cosmetic: in the 2024 demo, IGN reported that swapping weapons refilled Soul's stamina immediately and let a combo continue, which is why the game reads closer to Ninja Gaiden than to a FromSoftware fight. Sha-chi is the resource that pays for both heavy attacks and blocks.

Who plays him

Soul is portrayed by Yucheng, a model and stage actor. Character models across the cast were built from 3D scans, and facial capture came from the actors themselves.

What he is meant to represent

Director Soulframe Liang describes Soul as a xiake (侠客) - the Chinese, kung-fu formulation of the hero: reserved, not talkative, swift, cold outward and warm inward, disposed to help the weak while counting down his own remaining days.

sections.title: Mu Xiaokui (沐小葵) - The Founder's Daughter
sections.content:
Mu Xiaokui is the daughter of The Order's founder and a gifted young fighter positioned as a future leader, caught between her own place in the Jianghu and the expectations attached to the family name. She grew up alongside Soul.

She has her own thematic melody, and she has been given solo marketing weight: before pre-orders opened in August 2026, S-GAME released a 35-second teaser built entirely around her, showing her standing in front of a fire before leaving in what looked like a hot-air balloon. She is portrayed by actress Zhang Jinzhi.

Mu Xiaokui is not playable in Phantom Blade Zero, whatever her status in the mobile entries.

Name note. Her Chinese name is 沐小葵 - 沐, not 牧 - confirmed against Baidu Baike, the series wiki and Gamersky's coverage of her new model for this game. This page carried the wrong character until 22 October 2026.

sections.title: Zuo Shang (左殇) - The Blood Brother Turned Rival, And The Conspiracy
sections.content:
Nothing about Zuo Shang is a footnote, and the honest version is a correction. Earlier text on this page filed him as Soul's “trusted friend and companion”. He is neither.

Zuo Shang and Soul grew up together and trained kung fu together, fighting side by side until a tragedy split them into lifetime enemies. In the director's own framing the relationship is a Guts-and-Griffith or Dante-and-Vergil rivalry transposed into a wuxia setting. The duel that leaves Soul with a hole in his heart is Zuo Shang's duel - so he is simultaneously the deepest personal loss in the story and the proximate cause of its central condition.

He is portrayed by film-academy student Zhang Xince, and has his own thematic melody, derived from the same A minor material as Soul's and Mu Xiaokui's.

Zuo Shang is a non-playable character in Phantom Blade Zero. Whether the duel is a boss encounter, a scripted sequence, or something the player survives rather than wins has not been stated.

What The Launch Trailer Adds

Zuo Shang is Soul's oldest connection: the launch trailer released 21-22 October 2026 presents him as a friend raised alongside Soul in the Order, and gives him the trailer's framing scenes - his carriage crossing a wooden bridge into the blood-coloured forest, then a plot being arranged indoors with a figure he calls Lord Huang, in the name of upholding justice.

The detail that carries weight is visual rather than spoken. Across those shots his hair goes from black to white, arriving at the rain-night reunion with Soul fully changed. That is the trailer's one clear statement about the distance between the two of them, and it is presented without explanation.

Series references outside this game describe him as the one who took the leader's position after its founder was killed, and as Soul's sworn brother - carried here as context, not as a claim about this game's plot, since the reboot is not bound to reproduce it. S-GAME has not stated his role in Phantom Blade Zero.

One thing the trailer does confirm: he is not a boss shown in the combat reel. Whether you fight him has not been announced.

Played by Donnie Yen

Donnie Yen performs Mó Yuan, described by S-GAME's founder as Soul's father; the same actor's involvement in motion capture has been widely assumed to extend to other roles, but no official material links him to Zuo Shang. Anyone reporting that casting as fact is conflating two characters.

sections.title: Mo Yuan (魔源) - Donnie Yen's Character
sections.content:
The most star-attached role in the game. Donnie Yen is credited as the game's Creative Consultant on kung fu - a role he has held since 2023 - and he also provides the facial and motion capture for Mo Yuan. The official State of Play write-up calls the work with Yen one of the most exciting parts of the whole development, and says his encounter with the character leads into some of the game's most intense moments.

Two things are deliberately not claimed here:

  • He is Soul's father. This is official: S-Game founder Soulframe Liang, writing under his own byline on the PlayStation Blog (11 and 17 August 2026), calls Mó Yuan "our protagonist Soul's father". Earlier versions of this page said no official source existed, which was wrong - the claim was discounted because it first reached us through a secondary site.
  • He is a hidden boss. Also from Liang, in an August 2026 Bilibili post reported by GamingBolt, IGN and others: Mó Yuan is a "powerful hidden boss" who only appears after "a series of explorations and trials", so he is not on the critical path.
  • His title. S-Game's own pre-order announcement names him "Leader of the Bastion of Mó", revealed as the man cradling the infant in that trailer.
  • Whether he is a villain. “Major antagonist” is still a reading of trailer placement, not a published description.
  • Whether Donnie Yen voices him. One outlet credits him with the English voice performance; another notes the trailer did not state it. Unresolved.

The romanisation is unsettled: Mo Yuan, Mó Yuan and Mowan all appear across coverage of the same character.

What is confirmed: creative consultant since 2023, facial and motion capture, and Liang's own framing that Yen's involvement is "not another instance of a celebrity endorsing a game for commercial purposes". Liang also pointed out that Yen directed the intro cinematic for Capcom's Onimusha 3 two decades ago.

sections.title: The Flesh Sculptor - The Healer
sections.content:
The figure who keeps the story possible. Soul is brought back by a mysterious healer credited in the sources as The Flesh Sculptor, who revives him with a tainted heart and thereby sets the 66-day limit. The name is doing a lot of work in a game whose official vocabulary includes folk horror: the person who saves the protagonist is described in terms of craft applied to flesh, and the rescue is explicitly temporary.

Nothing further has been published about the character's motives or identity.

sections.title: Confirmed Named Characters
sections.content:
These names appear in official material or in reporting that cites it. Role descriptions are limited to what has actually been stated.

CharacterWhat is confirmed
SoulProtagonist, playable; ex-Order assassin; 66 days to live
ZuoshangFormer blood brother, now enemy; inflicted Soul's heart wound; played by Zhang Xince
Mu XiaokuiOrder founder's daughter; played by Zhang Jinzhi; subject of the pre-order teaser
Mo YuanPlayed by Donnie Yen, who is also the kung fu creative consultant
The Flesh SculptorMysterious healer; revived Soul with a tainted heart
The Order's patriarchMurdered; the crime Soul is framed for; identified in some coverage as his adoptive father
Seven StarsA name attached to a formation and to a boss; see the boss guide

Longer NPC lists circulating elsewhere - Dinghai, Old Beggar, Tang Li, Guizhi, Dugu Linghe - could not be traced to an official source during this pass, so they are omitted rather than repeated. If they are real, they will reappear with citations after release.

The non-playable subset is indexed separately at NPCs.
